description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the performance of two models across three datasets evaluated on two metrics, Exact Match (EM) and F1 score. The horizontal axis displays the categories, ordered from left to right as TriviaQA (EM), HotPotQA (EM), 2Wiki (EM), TriviaQA (F1), HotPotQA (F1), and 2Wiki (F1), with each label visually emphasized by a yellow highlighted background. The vertical axis represents the numerical value on a linear scale ranging from a baseline of 25 up to 85; it lacks an explicit axis title but features numeric tick labels at 25, 65, and 85, alongside horizontal grid lines spaced at intervals of 10. The chart uses grouped bars, where each category contains a pair of adjacent vertical bars. According to the legend in the top right, which also features yellow highlighting, the blue bars represent the Flan-T5-783M model and the red bars represent the GPT-4 model. Every bar is annotated with its exact value in white text near the top. For the Flan-T5-783M model (blue), the values are 77.3 for TriviaQA (EM), 37.0 for HotPotQA (EM), 44.5 for 2Wiki (EM), 82.8 for TriviaQA (F1), 49.7 for HotPotQA (F1), and 53.3 for 2Wiki (F1). For the GPT-4 model (red), the values are 77.1 for TriviaQA (EM), 31.9 for HotPotQA (EM), 32.5 for 2Wiki (EM), 83.8 for TriviaQA (F1), 43.3 for HotPotQA (F1), and 38.1 for 2Wiki (F1). The shortest bar in the chart is the red GPT-4 bar for HotPotQA (EM) at 31.9, while the tallest is the red GPT-4 bar for TriviaQA (F1) at 83.8. The bars are not sorted by value, but rather grouped sequentially by dataset and metric type.
